newsitem.title: USA: Apple CEO says on track for Q2 profitabiliy.
newsitem.headline: Apple CEO says on track for Q2 profitabiliy.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc Chairman and CEO Glibert Amelio said on Monday that while he would love to do it sooner, the company was on still track to return to profitability in the fiscal second quarter.
Amelio said the restructuring of Apple was well under way and that he was pleased the company would meet its targets, including stopping the flow of red ink in the second quarter of March, 1997.
"Our official communication is that we're on track for what I said, which is the second quarter of our year, " Amelio told Reuters in an interview. I have no reason to believe we won't do that."
He said it was possible improvements could come even quicker but he was not prepared to make any new forecasts.
"We'd all love it to happen sooner but I don't want to mislead people," Amelio, attending a Gartner Group technology conference, said.

Apple will report its fourth quarter on October 16. The consensus on Wall Street, according to First Call, is for a loss of $0.30 a share, versus a profit of $0.48 a share in the year-ago period. The company is currently in its quiet period and Amelio could not comment on the current quarter.

Amelio said he was pleased with a number of accomplishments since taking over earlier this year, including putting in place a new management team, articulating a strategic direction, establishing new business processes, attacking some of the product quality problems, and getting control of its inventories.
